I'll search hotels for your Seoul stay and load the relevant city skills.# Seoul Solo Trip — Draft Itinerary (20–23 Nov 2026)

**Overview**: Seoul 3 nights, one base, no hotel changes | light · standard · standard · light
Note: this is a draft. Seoul is outside my usual Japan coverage, so the city skills I loaded don't apply — the day plans below are general suggestions, and you should check opening hours and transport before going.

**Before you go**
- Get a T-money card at the airport or a convenience store for subway and buses.
- Book timed-entry or reservation-only places a few weeks ahead (please check current rules).
- Late November is cold and dark early (sunset approx. 17:15) — pack layers and plan indoor backups.
- Check your hotel's check-in time and whether early luggage drop is possible.

**Day 1 | Arrival · Myeongdong (light)**
- Arrive Incheon/Gimpo → AREX or airport bus to central Seoul, approx. 45–70 min depending on airport; allow extra time for immigration
- 15:00 Check in near Myeongdong, rest
- 17:00 Walk Myeongdong shopping street, approx. 10 min from the hotel: easy first-evening stroll
- 19:00 Dinner at a Myeongdong street-food stall or a casual restaurant, early night
- Tonight: Migliore Hotel Seoul Myeongdong (美利来酒店首尔明洞)

**Day 2 | Gyeongbokgung · Bukchon · Insadong (standard)**
- 09:00 Subway to Gyeongbokgung, approx. 15 min, no transfer (approx.)
- 09:30 Gyeongbokgung Palace and the changing of the guard: go early, it is calmest then
- 11:30 Walk approx. 15 min to Bukchon Hanok Village, slow loop through the alleys
- 13:00 Lunch in Samcheong-dong, approx. 10 min walk
- 15:00 Walk approx. 15 min to Insadong for tea and craft shops
- 18:00 Dinner near Insadong; subway back, approx. 15 min (approx.)
- Alternatives: if rain, the National Palace Museum and National Folk Museum instead of the palace grounds; if tired, drop Insadong
- Tonight: Migliore Hotel Seoul Myeongdong (美利来酒店首尔明洞)

**Day 3 | Namsan · Itaewon · Han River (standard)**
- 09:30 Walk approx. 15 min to the Namsan cable car, up to N Seoul Tower: morning views, fewer people
- 12:00 Walk down or bus to Itaewon, approx. 20 min (approx.); lunch there
- 14:00 Leeum Museum of Art area, approx. 15 min walk (many museums close on Mondays — please check)
- 17:00 Subway to a Han River park for sunset, approx. 20 min, 1 transfer (approx.)
- 19:00 Dinner near the river or back in Myeongdong
- Alternatives: if rain, the National Museum of Korea instead of the tower and river walk; if tired, drop the Han River stop
- Tonight: Migliore Hotel Seoul Myeongdong (美利来酒店首尔明洞)

**Day 4 | Departure (light)**
- Morning: breakfast and last souvenirs near the hotel only
- 11:00 Myeongdong → airport by AREX or airport bus, approx. 45–70 min (approx.); leave plenty of time for check-in

**Hotel note**: I picked the Myeongdong hotel as your single base — central for all three days and the cheapest of the central options. If you'd rather be in Hongdae for nightlife, Local Stitch Creator Town Seogyo-dong is cheaper but further from the sights. Prices shown are the lowest found for 20–23 Nov; please confirm availability before booking.

items.summary: Closest to Myeongdong of the options, 3.5 stars, lowest price of the central picks; some rooms have no window.
